turns.text: Ugh, hi, my flight today to London got cancelled and I need to get my family on another one.
I'm sorry about that, I'll help get you rebooked. Can I have your booking code and last name, please?
Yeah, it's ZQ7D1C, Patel. Raj Patel. Ugh, this is such a mess.
Thank you, Mr. Patel, you're verified. I see SK212 to London at 14:30 today was cancelled by us because of weather, with four passengers on Economy.
Right, that's the one. So what's the next flight out? And, wait, will the kids' seats stay together?

The next available flight is SK214 at 23:55 tonight, and there are nine seats open, so all four of you fit. Because we cancelled, the rebooking is free with no fare difference. I can't see seat maps from here, so I can't promise the seats will be together, but I can note the request.
Ugh, 23:55? That's almost midnight. There's nothing earlier? Sighs, okay, what about a hotel, we'd be stuck at the airport all day with two kids.

The 08:10 has already left, and the 14:30 is the one that was cancelled, so 23:55 is the next one. A hotel voucher up to $120 only applies when an airline delay runs overnight, and this flight leaves tonight, so I can't offer one.
That's not great. Is there anything you can do for us, a lounge or something, I've got a four-year-old here.
I'm sorry, I can't offer lounge access or any compensation beyond our policy. I can arrange a supervisor callback if you'd like to ask them about it.
Ugh, fine, whatever, skip the callback. Just put us on the 23:55, all four of us, and note the seats together thing.

Done, all four of you are rebooked on SK214 tonight at 23:55 at no charge, with a note asking for seats together. To sum up, your cancelled SK212 was moved to SK214 for free, and no hotel voucher applies. Is there anything else?
